model_name: Dual-Polarimetric Sentinel-1 U-Net (Corrected Input dB Normalization)
scientific_classification: Experimental candidate oil-spill anomaly detection model

radiometric_normalization.pre_v4_defect_resolved: Eliminated positive-value rejection bug (arr > 0) that produced zero-tensors for negative dB SAR inputs

dataset_splits.protocol: Strict scene-level partitioning (Zero geographical or temporal leakage)

threshold_selection.selection_dataset: 7 Validation Scenes strictly (Zero test scene leakage)
threshold_selection.selection_rule: Deterministic maximization of validation Dice score while minimizing validation FPR
threshold_selection.operational_safety_note: Threshold 0.50 retains a 25.26% validation FPR and is not safe for standalone alerting.

strengths: Corrected SAR dB normalization successfully restored spatial gradient flow and feature learning.
True positive pixel discovery on held-out test benchmark increased from 0 in V2 to 73,886 in V4.
Strong selectivity against uniform clean ocean water (Clean-Ocean FPR < 0.3%).
Clear separation in output probability distribution between true oil (median 0.978) and clean water (median 0.020).
limitations: Severe false alarm rate on low-wind and biogenic look-alike regions (Look-Alike FPR ≈ 59.55%).
Low positive predictive value / precision (≈ 1.6%–1.8%) on unconstrained satellite scenes.
Physical inability of standalone single-sensor dual-pol backscatter to distinguish biological surfactant films from crude oil without meteorological context.
operational_recommendation: Maintain Model V2 as baseline in demo / UI; classify Model V4 as an experimental candidate requiring multimodal MetOcean wind conditioning and AIS reverse-drift trajectory fusion.
